from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,statistics,os
root=Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc');p=root/'tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/parameter-scoped-graphs'
def read(name):return json.loads((p/name).read_text())
def save(name,v):(p/name).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
h=read('frozen-sources.json');changed=[f for f,v in h.items() if sha(root/f)!=v];assert not changed,changed
(p/'final-sources.json').write_bytes((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_bytes())
shaders=root/'target/stdlib-perf/results/current-shaders'
shader_hashes={str(f.relative_to(shaders)):sha(f) for f in sorted(shaders.rglob('*')) if f.is_file()}
save('current-shader-hashes.json',shader_hashes)
for f in (p/'warmup').glob('*.json'):
 d=json.loads(f.read_text());assert d['exit_code']==0 and sha(shaders/d['shader'])==d['sha256'],d
suites={}
for name,count in [('library',4),('native',14)]:
 d=read(name+'.json');assert d['exit_code']==0 and d['frozen_sources_unchanged'] and len(d['passed'])==count,d;suites[name]=count
comparisons={}
for directory in ['performance-contracts','performance-ordinary']:
 runs=[json.loads(f.read_text()) for f in sorted((p/directory).glob('[0-3]-*.json'))]
 assert len(runs)==4 and all(r['exit_code']==0 and r['output_verified'] and r['sources_unchanged'] and r['shader_link_restored'] and len(r['samples_ms'])==10 for r in runs)
 medians={v:statistics.median([t for r in runs if r['version']==v for t in r['samples_ms']]) for v in ['baseline','current']}
 c={'runs':runs,'pooled_median_ms':medians,'change_percent':100*(medians['current']/medians['baseline']-1),'method':'Existing stdlib_gpu_perf; identical preserved Rust binary; exact previous checkpoint shaders vs frozen new shaders; ABBA; 3 warmups and 10 measured entry rebuilds per run; output verification after every run.','limits':['Two focused workloads; no cross-compiler or canonical1MB claim.','Cold preparation cost excluded from warm measurements.','No attribution of observed speedup to a specific shader.']}
 save(directory+'/comparison.json',c);comparisons[directory]={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='runs'}
manifest={'status':'18 selected correctness checks pass; shared parameter-identity graph capability verified','suites':suites,'source_files':len(h),'source_snapshot':'final-sources.json','shader_files':len(shader_hashes),'shader_snapshot':'current-shader-hashes.json','frozen_sources_unchanged':True,'performance':comparisons,'initial_attempts':'Initial library run and traced diagnostic timed out during cold pipeline preparation. First run had an overlapping native build which was stopped and is not accepted evidence. Subsequent clean, warmed library and native runs pass.','cold_pipeline':'03k2_materialize_match_payloads completed in57545ms; prior historical cold measurements roughly47-52s, not a matched before/after cold measurement.','execution_target':'Physical GPU executes compiler graph checks. Emitted user programs execute as x86_64 Linux ELF. User-program GPU execution not established.','limits':['Source adapters still retain existing slot/environment policies; exact-identity packed graph adapter is next.','Existing shared walkers preserve depth64 but do not have a traversal visit budget; packed consumer requires admission with explicit per-root work bounds.','Program catalog coherence/selection, owned evidence and imported replay proof validation remain unimplemented.']}
save('verification.json',manifest)
for path,name in [('/tmp/lanius-scoped-graph-verify.py','verification-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-scoped-perf.py','performance-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-scoped-warm.py','warmup-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-scoped-finish.py','finish-runner.txt')]: (p/name).write_bytes(Path(path).read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
